blocks.text: Sagging Skin Treatment near Cedar Park

blocks.html: As collagen production decreases with age, skin appears less supple and will begin to droop. A Cedar Park laser treatment for face and neck will transform that sagging skin into a more supple and younger look.

blocks.text: Cedar Park Laser Treatment for Textured Skin

blocks.html: There are many reasons that skin begins to become harsh and rough. Aging, sun damage, and elements in the environment can give your skin a harsh and textured look. You may even start to develop large pores on your face, which are the result of an increase in sebum production. A Cedar Park laser treatment can eliminate these problems and take your textured skin back to a smooth and more contoured look.
Where your face was once smooth, over time you may notice fine lines or even crow’s feet, a cluster of wrinkles around your eyes. As skin begins to lose collagen, wrinkles begin to form.

An IPL photofacial is a noninvasive laser therapy that uses intense pulsed light (IPL). The light travels below your skin without harming the surface area and removes targeted cells or pigmentation that is then naturally flushed out, leaving you with healthy cells and collagen that replace the damaged ones.
